description: This file defines the interface 'SchedularWritePlatformService', which declares methods related to managing scheduled jobs and scheduler details within the system. It primarily serves as a contract for implementing classes that handle CRUD operations on scheduled job data and fetch scheduler metadata.

classes.name: SchedularWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for managing scheduled jobs and scheduler configurations, including retrieval, updating, and processing job details.

methods.name: retrieveAllJobs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all scheduled jobs for a given node identifier.

methods.name: findByJobKey
methods.description: Finds a scheduled job detail using its trigger key.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a scheduled job detail.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a scheduled job detail along with its run history.

methods.name: fetchMaxVersionBy
methods.description: Fetches the maximum version number for a given trigger key.

methods.name: findByJobId
methods.description: Finds a scheduled job detail by its unique job ID.

methods.name: updateJobDetail
methods.description: Updates a job detail identified by job ID using data from a JSON command.

methods.name: retriveSchedulerDetail
methods.description: Retrieves details about the scheduler configuration.

methods.name: processJobDetailForExecution
methods.description: Processes a job detail for execution based on job key and trigger type.
